rounds.renderer: Headless Chromium with SwiftShader software GL; valid for composition and labels only. Perf sign-off is invalid; no device/GPU performance claim.

findings.summary: Only Unit 1 appeared to return water through the tailrace, while explanatory copy said turbine water returns to the river.
findings.resolution: All four unit flows now pass through a tailrace node and end at the shared downstream river. The overview science reviewer confirmed all four paths return in WebGL and FALLBACK_2D.

findings.summary: An emissive city-load mesh and overlapping city structures appeared as a bright block at the WebGL scene's right edge.
findings.resolution: Reduced additive emissive wash and narrowed city-load meshes; the visual reviewer confirmed distinct city-side structures within scene bounds.

findings.summary: The mobile explanation panel cut off text without signaling that more explanation was available.
findings.resolution: Added a visible scroll cue above the explanation. The visual reviewer confirmed discoverability in the mobile overview still; live scrolling remains untested.

findings.summary: The desktop exploded Unit 3 stack clipped the generator and did not clearly show the runner.
findings.resolution: Added a wider exploded-bench camera preset. Reviewers confirm all three parts are separated and visible in the selected correction captures.

findings.summary: The seeded challenge-start state already satisfied the hospital-supply objective.
findings.resolution: Challenge start now keeps feeders on at dry flow with one unit, so the model truthfully reports an unmet state. Tests and all eight profile/viewport captures confirm this.

findings.summary: Assessment preview scenarios passed later checks out of order and showed stale feedback under a different active task.
findings.resolution: Seeded previews now complete preceding checks in order, leave the intended check active, clear old success feedback before repair, and use generic part instructions. Replay assertions and focused captures confirm the seeded states and wording; live assessment completion remains untested.

findings.summary: The S7 name-chain capture previously showed the Unit 3 machine task instead of the energy-chain task.
findings.resolution: S7 is now the seventh guided task, displays the energy-chain prompt, and places its explanation at the top of the panel. Science review accepted the explicit gravitational-potential and kinetic-energy wording.

findings.summary: Fallback 2D completed-assessment scene had clipped transmission pylons and crowded labels.
findings.resolution: SVG omits removed cutaway solids. The completed scenario resets to the valley camera; the latest 8-image profile/viewport capture shows pylon geometry fully in frame. Visual re-review says Intake, Unit 1/2 housing, Generator, and Switchyard labels remain crowded in the centered desktop scene. This P2 remains for label spacing only.

findings.summary: Peripheral scene labels were crowded around the LOW mobile powerhouse cutaway.
findings.resolution: The 56758033 full still matrix shows peripheral labels no longer crowded against the right edge; the primary river and machine labels remain readable.

findings.summary: At 557 m³/s river input, the captured WebGL flood scene did not make the modeled 127 m³/s spillway consequence readily discernible in a paused reduced-motion still.
findings.resolution: The shared WebGL renderer draws process lines and static particle cues above solids, and the spillway follows the dam face in the active-water palette. Science review confirms the paused cue is visible in HIGH, STANDARD, and LOW; FALLBACK_2D also shows an unmistakable path and arrow. This proves state and placement, not animation.

disagreements.topic: find-generator originally targeted u1-generator, while the asset plan contains one detailed unit 3 stack.
disagreements.resolution: The check identifies u3-generator; the model remains equivalent across units and no science claim depends on unit identity.
disagreements.why: Keeping one internal stack makes the cutaway and repair check reachable on LOW.

disagreements.topic: Whether the static spin glyph should appear only for reduced motion or across WebGL profiles.
disagreements.resolution: Render the accessible static glyph for every active motion group on every profile; use the off-axis pole marker as the in-scene spin cue. Round 1 captures confirm glyphs are present in every profile; the reviewer confirms desktop legibility but cannot establish individual glyph legibility on mobile, so later review must revisit it.
disagreements.why: The glyph makes state perceivable without relying on animation, and the marker supports visual interpretation.

disagreements.topic: The proposed #94a3b8 inactive grey cannot meet both the contrast and fuchsia-highlight separation gates with the selected highlight token.
disagreements.resolution: Use shared #779ab2 after-alpha contrast and ΔE00 gates; retain active water #67e8f9 and spill #cffafe after palette checks.
disagreements.why: The measured token meets 3:1 contrast and the shared colour-separation gates.

tradeoffs.what: Mount Coffee hydraulics and feeder demands are intentionally simplified; several seasonal rates and every feeder MW value are model assumptions.
tradeoffs.why: The model focuses on grade 8 cause and effect and is explicitly labelled as a non-scale instructional model.

tradeoffs.what: The HIGH experience uses procedural primitives rather than photoreal terrain, fluid simulation, or downloaded assets.
tradeoffs.why: The brief prioritizes comprehension, offline reach and reliable LOW/2D rendering.

tradeoffs.what: Software GL captures can support composition and label review only.
tradeoffs.why: They do not measure GPU/device performance, battery, memory or real-device frame rate.
